_help.balanceReady: Muzzy's sign-off: true once the AI personalities are built AND feel right to him (Personality Check green + his own games). Until then, balance sims made of AI games (npm run ai:balance, npm run sim:awards -- --players ai) refuse to run — tuning the game's rules or awards from an AI that isn't there yet would tune them to the wrong players. Flip it back to false if the AI changes a lot.
_help.signedOff: When and why Muzzy signed off (e.g. "2026-10-20 — RPS fixed, played 5 games, each personality feels like itself").

_labels.balanceReady: AI ready for balance sims (Muzzy's sign-off)
